rules.rationale: Trusted #Ceil characterization of K's existing partial Val-to-Int cast; Stage 1 does not prove this statement in a module that omits the rule.
Guarded equation defining the new projectIntTotal proof term by the existing partial Int projection.
Unproved reverse-orientation fact equating K's existing Int cast with projectIntTotal under isInt; it is not merely a new-symbol-headed definition.
Defines projectIntTotal on an argument already statically sorted as Int.
Additional dynamic-to-static comparison fact about the existing applyCmp symbol; it is trusted by simplification and has no separate rule-free proof.
Defines the new isNumericV predicate as the union of the represented Int, Bool, and Float sorts.
Base equation defining allNumericVS on the empty value sequence.
Structural recurrence defining allNumericVS on a cons value sequence.
